title: chooseProject
responsibility: Asks the person to pick a folder to open as a project and returns it, or null when they cancel.

inputs.name: chooseProject.window
inputs.description: The Electron window that the folder picker is opened for. The function passes it unchanged as the first argument to dialog.showOpenDialog and never reads its properties or checks that it is still open.

inputs.name: chooseProject.dialog
inputs.description: The Electron dialog object whose showOpenDialog method opens the folder picker. The function calls showOpenDialog once per call, with the title 'Open a Harness project' and the properties ['openDirectory'], and reads only the canceled and filePaths fields of the result.

outputs.name: chooseProject
outputs.description: Resolves once the person has finished with the dialog, to the path of the folder they picked or to null when they cancel. The path is the first entry of the dialog's filePaths array, and null is also returned when the dialog is not canceled but that array is empty.
